name: Memgraph
model: Property graph queried with Cypher (Bolt protocol, Neo4j-compatible drivers); in-memory, aimed at streaming and real-time graph analytics
engine_note: In-memory graph with MVCC (written in C++); durability by write-ahead log plus periodic snapshots; optional on-disk storage mode
consistency: ACID transactions in the default IN_MEMORY_TRANSACTIONAL mode; SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION by default, READ_COMMITTED and READ_UNCOMMITTED as options. IN_MEMORY_ANALYTICAL mode drops ACID. Replicas via SYNC, ASYNC or STRICT_SYNC; async replicas can lag.
scaling: Bigger machine (the graph must fit in RAM); read replicas; automatic failover with Raft coordinators is Enterprise only.
licence: Business Source License 1.1 (Community, change licence Apache 2.0 after 4 years); Memgraph Enterprise License

licence_events.event: Memgraph 2.0 released with source under BSL 1.1 (Community Edition) and the Memgraph Enterprise License; each version converts to Apache 2.0 four years after release

reach: Reach for it when you need low-latency graph queries over fast-changing data (streams from Kafka, fraud scoring) and the graph fits in RAM.
avoid: Avoid when the graph is bigger than memory, you need an OSI open-source licence, or you want automatic failover without Enterprise.
escape: real-time multi-hop graph queries in memory, where Postgres recursive joins are too slow
chat: Live graph of users, shared chats and entities for real-time abuse or fraud detection.
notes: Licence verified from LICENSE and licenses/BSL.txt (BSL 1.1 'as amended by the additional use grant', dated January 1, 2026): production use allowed for internal business purposes, but not embedding/distributing to third parties, offering as a database service, or building a competing product; change licence Apache 2.0 at the change date (currently 2030-14-09 as written in the file, i.e. 14 Sep 2030) or four years after a version's release. The licence text was revised 2026-01-28 ('Update licenses' commit cef597d); I could not confirm what changed, so it is not listed as an event. Licence files first added 2021-10-03; v2.0.0 released 2021-10-06; whether 1.x was closed source is unconfirmed. Durability by WAL plus snapshots not stated on the fetched transactions page; from general Memgraph docs, not re-checked. No Jepsen analysis.
